**(b) Top-to-bottom order:**

- Sachet Water: title → ₵6.00/wk → chips (WKLY only, no REQ/REQ-equivalent and no status chip) → Collect → 6.00 input. ⚠ Chip pattern deviates from spec.
- Extra Classes (remedial, bottom card): title → ₵3.00/d → REQ chip only (no WKLY/OPT, no status chip) → Collect → 3.00 input. ⚠ Incomplete chips row.
Ordering is correct, but the chips row is inconsistent across cards.

**(c) Problems:**
- Top-right card title truncated with ellipsis: "Extra Classes (remedi" — quoted verbatim from the screenshot.
- Top two pink cards are clipped by the viewport: only "…charged · owing" fragments visible, titles unreadable.
- "0 charged · 0 owing" appears clipped to "0 charged" / "0 owing" — subtitle line truncated.
- Chips rows inconsistent/missing elements (see b), which reads as misaligned design rather than text clipping, but is a defect.
- Bottom "Total" label is clipped at the screenshot's bottom edge ("otal" visible).

**(d) Score: 5/10.** The layout structure and card anatomy are clean and consistent in the lower cards, but an ellipsized card title, clipped cards at the top, and inconsistent chip rows across nominally identical cards undermine the professional polish expected of a fee portal.
